# Quickler

> Quickler is a WhatsApp field compliance platform for UK trades. Engineers receive compliance questions on WhatsApp; their replies, voice notes and photos generate timestamped PDF reports automatically. Use cases include EICR electrical certificates, CP12 gas safety certificates, daily van safety checks and structural site inspection reports.

## Product

Quickler sends structured compliance questions to engineers on WhatsApp, accepts text, transcribed voice notes and photos as replies, and produces a formatted PDF report automatically. Faults are flagged on a manager dashboard with red, amber and green status, and every record is stored timestamped against the engineer, the job and the date. There is no app to install and no login for engineers.

### Best-fit users
- Electricians (EICRs, periodic inspection reports, minor works)
- Gas Safe registered engineers (CP12 landlord gas safety, service records)
- Structural engineers (site inspection reports)
- Surveyors and site inspectors
- M&E contractors
- Van fleet operators (DVSA daily walkround checks)
- Any UK trades firm with engineers submitting compliance data from site

## Proof

- Across delivered workflow projects the measured saving came to 51.5 working days per year, with an average return of roughly 12x on time invested.
- Previous delivered work includes reporting automation, production tracking, sales-data restructuring, and grant-application workflow improvements.

## Background

quickler Ltd was founded by Philip Ross. He studied Electrical and Mechanical Engineering at the University of Strathclyde and previously worked at Dijuno, where he built experience in LLM testing, prompt engineering, and Python automation.

## Technologies

Python, Flask, Typst, Google Apps Script, Claude, Looker Studio, Docker Compose
